comment: Explicit quran-align index maps (qaToWord[q] = index into the 2016/17 word list, basmala excluded; -1 = no word). Decided from audio evidence: scripts/sync-check.ts + the pause after the muqatta'at (each has a pause mark ۚ after it). See DECISIONS.md D-006.

10:1.evidence: audio: pause 5.0–5.75 s; qa [0,1) 550–5850 ms = الٓر incl. the pause, so qa 3 (5860 ms) is تِلْكَ

14:1.evidence: audio: pause 5070–5650 ms ends where qa 2 starts (5660 ms) → qa 2 = كِتَٰبٌ; last segment ends 21150 ms before the trailing silence (21450 ms)

15:1.evidence: audio: pause 5260–5620 ms falls inside qa 2 (2750–6240); the alternative (+2) leaves 630 ms of speech before تِلْكَ unassigned and drops مُّبِينٍ; voice ends ≈11.3 s = end of qa 6
